banner.title: The UA promotion batch four - rounds R365 through R380 complete - the Unearthed Arcana set open
banner.provenance: The UA promotion arc round four, the fourth rules promotion batch from the Unearthed Arcana pin rounds: sixteen records promoted into content/rules/ua/ - rounds R365 through R380 complete (the illusionist 6th/7th spells with the acquisition and cost pins, the DM-section spells, the social class and birth, the cavalier table and followers, the cantrip acquisition, the DM-section smalls, the expanded armor, the comeliness note, the treasure dial, the determination skeleton, and the potions, scrolls, rings, rods, staves and wands prose), one record per round per the OA header-record doctrine (the pin header stays the adjudicated record; the multi-header rounds merge their headers' pools), 1355 model items (consts, bools, switches, chains), every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof), the audit conditions converted to bad-detector examples. This batch is 277802 bytes of Lua. Cumulative forty-five of the 76-round UA set, 31 rounds remaining.
